title: Sam & Layla — Ep. 1 — P01: Cold open + title
summary: Sam yells at a dirt mound. Layla: trees take years. Title sting.

lines.tts: [intense, building to a shout] Grow. Grow... grow!
lines.note: COLD OPEN, CU ground level: Sam crouched, nose almost in the dirt, eyes huge. Each 'grow' louder.

lines.text: Sam... why are you yelling at dirt?
lines.tts: [puzzled, flat] Sam... why are you yelling at dirt?
lines.note: WS reveal: tiny mound in a big yard (house, fence, hills). Layla walks in from the right with a knitting bag.

lines.text: I'm not yelling. I'm *motivating* a tree.
lines.tts: [proudly] I'm not yelling. I'm motivating a tree.
lines.note: He does not look away from the mound.
She looks around the empty yard.

lines.text: Right there! Under the dirt. Probably huge by now.
lines.tts: [excited] Right there! Under the dirt. Probably huge by now.
lines.note: He points down at the mound.

lines.tts: [gently amused] Yesterday? Sam, trees take time.

lines.text: How much time? An hour? Two hours?
lines.tts: [hopeful, quickly] How much time? An hour? Two hours?
lines.note: Rule of three: a shrug, one hand up, both hands up, leaning in more each time.
CU Sam frozen, eye twitch; crickets ~1.4 s; Pip the bird chirps once on the fence.
He narrows his eyes. SMASH to TITLE STING: 'SAM & LAYLA' / 'Episode 1: Grow Faster!' (2.2 s, ink draw-on, pop + whoosh).

beats: OPEN (0-5 s): late-morning establishing EWS of the yard (house, fence, hills, sun, clouds drifting); Pip lands on the fence and chirps; slow push-in towards the garden where Sam crouches by the mound.
l11 gap: the longest awkward beat of the film — crickets, Sam's eye twitch (CU), Pip chirps once.
HOLD (8 s): smash to the TITLE: 'SAM & LAYLA' draws on (theme sting), 'Episode 1: Grow Faster!' pops in, Pip flutters across the card; fade out.
